description: This file defines the 'delimited_formatter' class used for formatting structure fields with customizable delimiters and formatting options, primarily for use in channel processor structures within the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: delimited_formatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting structure fields with customizable delimiters and formatting modes, supporting verbose and compact representations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses format specifiers to set delimiters and formatting modes, supporting 'n' for newline, ';' for semicolon, and 's' for short mode.

methods.name: format_always
methods.description: Formats fields with provided format string and arguments, always including delimiters.

methods.name: format_if_verbose
methods.description: Formats fields only if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: is_verbose
methods.description: Returns whether verbose formatting mode is active.
